body:
They say that if you’re nervous during a speech, you should picture the audience naked. If that makes you uncomfortable, there’s always the alternative of embracing the speech-imbuing mastery that is a Blue Lace Agate stone. The lack of lore surrounding this silky, soft variety of banded chalcedony stems from how recently it was discovered. Unlike other forms of Agate that have been around since the time of the ancient Greeks, Blue Lace Agate is a rare form of Agate that was discovered within the last 60 years.

For such a newcomer, it has already established an impressive reputation for its metaphysical properties. The Blue Lace Agate meaning connects to the throat chakra to empower you with the peace of mind you need to relax into your words. Instead of getting tripped up over your thoughts, this crystal clears the blocks between your mind and throat with a soothing energy. It allows you to express yourself in a way that is both authentic and articulate.

The fusion between Blue Lace Agate and your throat, third eye and crown chakras emboldens you to embark on new beginnings. As it nurtures fears and doubts away with a sense of tranquility, it establishes a feeling of quiet resolve to go in its place. The pairing of inner-peace and confidence is a powerful one when taking on measured risks. Freeing yourself of the fear of rejection or the fear of failure allows you to grow. Accept exciting experiences into your life in a way that is still calm, rational and healthy with the help of the Blue Lace Agate properties.

As one of the premier crystals for easing worry, seek comfort with a Blue Lace Agate stone in times of feeling stressed, anxious and overwhelmed. Let its soft, powder blue stripes melt away any fear or panic, and float your way to a more relaxed tomorrow.

This stone is wonderful for those who have trouble expressing themselves, for fear of judgment from others. Connect with the Blue Lace Agate meaning to unblock your throat chakra and speak your truth. This stone’s energy will clear a path for words to flow more authentically through you.

Your spirit may also be reaching for Blue Lace Agate during bouts of panic or worry. It’s easy to get trapped in the downward spiral of over-analysis and worrying about the future. When it feels like there’s no way out, call on this Blue Lace Agate to calm a troubled mind and clear away toxic vibes. This stone will help you find your inner peace.
